digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program and code quality enforcement
propositions: Bug provenance detection and trend queryability must be observable at creation time without requiring new user input

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must block raw git writes, unread config fields, unconstrained wall-clock assertions, incomplete AC checkboxes, dead code-comment citations, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python following strangler-fig policy
Canary and automation bug filing must follow hardened deduplication patterns and enforce a documented bug-creation contract
Code comments must cite tickets instead of dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates, with CI guards preventing regression
Plan-review gates must enforce engine-layer validation placement and block oversized bug fixes lacking signed review attestation
